# DESIGN.MD — Motion.dev Design System (checked out) > Source: https://motion.dev/ (live audit: HTML + CSS bundles + JS bundles) > Scope: multi-page design spec. **`/studio` intentionally skipped** (out of scope). > Rule: **all animations replicate motion.dev exactly as-is** (same easings, durations, keyframes, spring configs — values extracted from production bundles, not approximations). --- ## 1. Identity & Voice - **Product:** Motion (prev. Framer Motion) — production-grade animation library for React / JavaScript / Vue. - **Tone:** terse, technical, confident. Headlines end with a period: *“Animations that move.”*, *“Trusted by the world’s leading teams.”* - **Aesthetic:** “lab dossier” — hard 1px rules, mono labels, numbered indices (`01`, `02`…), full-bleed accent bands, dark-first. ## 2. Typography | Role | Family | Spec | |---|---|---| | Sans (display/body) | **TASA Orbiter** (variable) — fallback `sans-serif` | `font-variation-settings: "opsz" 40–80, "wght" 460–720` | | Mono (labels/code) | **Geist Mono** — fallback `ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas` | 11px min, uppercase, `letter-spacing: .12em`, `wght 560` | **Type scale (extracted):** | Element | Size | Weight/opsz | Tracking | Line-height | |---|---|---|---|---| | Home hero title (`.home-hero-title`) | `clamp(20px, 5.4vw, 48px)` | `"opsz" 60, "wght" 720` (rest line: 460) | `-0.05em` | 1 | | Page header title (`.fresh-page-header-title`) | `clamp(40px, 4.4vw, 42px)` | `"opsz" 50, "wght" 660` | `-0.04em` | 1.05 | | Section title (`.fresh-section-heading h1/h2/h3`) | `clamp(28px, 4vw, 40px)` | `"opsz" 48, "wght" 720` | `-0.035em` | 1.05, `text-wrap: balance` | | Base `h1` (docs/app) | `40px` | `"wght" 690, "opsz" 60` | — | — | | Nav links / buttons / labels | `11px` (`--fresh-min-mono`) | `wght 560–620` | `.12em` | `1.25`, uppercase | | Sans minimum | `12px` (`--fresh-min-sans`) | — | — | — | | Titles-small (`--fresh-type-title`) | `20px` | — | — | — | - Accent word in titles: `` renders in `color: var(--accent)` with `font-style: normal`. - Emphasis split in hero: **mark** = `wght 720`, **rest** = `wght 460`. ## 3. Color ### 3.1 App theme (`data-mode` × `data-scheme`), default = **dark + amber** ```css /* dark + amber (site default) */ --background: #0e1312; --layer: #141a18; --border: #1e2623; --foreground: #ededec; --foreground-feint: #958d82; --accent: #ffe023; --accent-light: rgba(255,224,35,.10); --accent-feint: rgba(255,224,35,.06); --on-accent: #171309; --surface-deep: #0a0804; --surface-deepest: #060402; --code-bg: #1a1814; --code-border: #2a2620; /* light + amber */ --background: #fcfaf4; --layer: #ffffff; --border: #e8e0c8; --foreground: #2e2a18; --foreground-feint: #7a6a40; --accent: #ffe023; --accent-light: rgba(255,224,35,.12); --code-bg: #f6f0e4; --code-border: #e8e0c8; ``` **Alternate schemes (same token names):** `emerald` (#34d399/#10b981), `rose` (#fb7185), `blue` (#60a5fa/#2563eb), `purple` (#a78bfa/#7c3aed), `red` (#f87171/#dc2626), `mono` (#e8eeee), `mint` (Motion+ exclusive, `--motion-plus-accent`). ### 3.2 “Fresh” marketing system (oklch lab palette) ```css --lab-ink: oklch(.145 .01 148); /* dark paper */ --lab-ink-raised: oklch(.18 .012 148); --lab-paper: oklch(.94 .008 96); --lab-muted: oklch(.69 .012 148); --lab-line: oklch(.31 .012 148); --lab-yellow: oklch(.88 .18 96); /* primary accent */ --lab-rind: oklch(.76 .15 155); /* green */ --lab-blueberry: oklch(.68 .18 255); /* blue */ --lab-blackcurrant: oklch(.64 .18 302); --lab-dragonfruit: oklch(.72 .2 345); --lab-watermelon: oklch(.67 .22 26.43); /* favourite/heart */ ``` Mapping: `--fresh-paper → --lab-paper`, `--fresh-ink → --lab-ink`, `--fresh-accent → --lab-yellow`, `--fresh-line → --lab-line`. ## 4. Layout / Grid ```css --fresh-grid-max-width: 1440px; --fresh-grid-gutter: clamp(20px, 5vw, 76px); --fresh-grid-gap: clamp(16px, 2.1vw, 32px); --fresh-grid-content-edge: max(gutter, (100vw - 1440px)/2 + gutter); ``` - Section headings: **12-column grid** — index `1 / 4`, title `4 / 10`, action `10 / -1`. - `.fresh-rule-grid`: N columns (`--fresh-rule-columns`, default 4), `gap: 1px`, `background: var(--fresh-line)`, cells `padding: 22px; background: var(--fresh-raised)` → hairline “dossier” tables. - Full-bleed hero: `width:100vw; margin-left:-50vw` breakout from container. - Sticky nav frame: `position: sticky; top: 12px`, inset computed from content-edge (desktop only). ## 5. Components ### 5.1 Navigation (global, sticky) - Height `72px` (mobile `60px`), 3-column grid: brand | links | actions. - Background = **accent yellow**, foreground = ink; content pages add `backdrop-filter: blur(5px)` + diagonal stripe overlay: `repeating-linear-gradient(angle, ink@40% 0 … 2px … 8px)` (dossier stripes). - Links: Geist Mono 11px uppercase `.12em`, `min-height: 44px`, padding `8px 12px`. - **Rolling-text hover** (`.fresh-rolling-text`): two stacked copies (`--incoming` absolutely overlaid) — outgoing rolls up/out, incoming rolls in (overflow hidden). Used on labels (“Docs”, “Examples”, badges like “New”). - Actions: Search trigger, `+`, Login, **Purchase**. - Focus: `outline: 2px solid currentColor; outline-offset: 3px`. ### 5.2 Buttons ```css .fresh-primary-action { min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 18px; border: 1px solid var(--accent); background: var(--accent); color: var(--ink); font: mono 11px/1.25 uppercase; letter-spacing: .12em; wght 620; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; overflow: hidden; isolation: isolate; } ``` - Secondary action = same geometry, transparent bg, 1px line border. - Hover: fill sweeps via `clip-path` wipe; icon/arrow translates. - Home hero score CTA variant: `min-width: 180px; min-height: 54px`. ### 5.3 Cards / thumbnails - `.fresh-item-thumbnail-media`: `aspect-ratio: 4/3`, `border: 1px solid var(--line)`, bg = ink. - `img` hover `transform: scale()` — `transition: transform .4s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)`. - `video` preview crossfades in on hover — `opacity .3s ease`, `z-index: 1`. - Border hover — `border-color .18s cubic-bezier(.25,1,.5,1)`. - Platform badge pinned `top:8px; left:8px; 22px`. - Favourite heart: 28px button, color → `--lab-watermelon` when saved, `transition: color .16s ease`. ### 5.4 Checkbox / small controls - 16px square, `border 1px line`, checked → `background: accent; color: ink`, `transition: border-color .14s, background-color .14s, color .14s`. ### 5.5 Code blocks - `--code-bg` + `--code-border`, mono 13px; docs console uses a **clip-path sweep** reveal (see §6). ## 6. Motion Spec — **EXACT as-is from motion.dev** > These values are copied verbatim from motion.dev’s production CSS/JS. Do not “improve” them. ### 6.1 Easing tokens | Token | Value | Used for | |---|---|---| | `ease-expo-out` | `cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1)` | transforms, image zoom, button bg, micro-interactions | | `ease-quint-out` | `cubic-bezier(.25, 1, .5, 1)` | borders, clip reveals, nav states | | `ease-wipe` | `cubic-bezier(.25, 0, 0, 1)` | clip-path wipes/sweeps, positioning | | `linear` (`ease: a=>a`) | identity | scroll-linked + keyframe timing demos | | demo-loop | `ease: [.5, 0, .5, 1]` | motion-value pendulum loop | ### 6.2 Durations (observed) `0.12s` color · `0.14s` checkbox · `0.15–0.18s` micro hover · `0.2–0.25s` insets/panels · `0.28–0.34s` max-width/clip · `0.4–0.55s` image zoom & wipes · `0.3s` video crossfade. ### 6.3 Keyframes (verbatim) ```css @keyframes fade-in { 0% { opacity: 0 } } @keyframes slide-up { 0% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(8px) } } @keyframes docs-console-sweep { 0% { clip-path: inset(0 100% 0 0) } to { clip-path: inset(0 0 0 0) } } @keyframes home-showcase-pulse { 0% { background-position: 200% 0 } to { background-position: -200% 0 } } @keyframes home-diag-row { 0%,30% { transform: translate(0); opacity: 1 } 55%,70% { transform: translate(-12%); opacity: 0 } 85%,to { transform: translate(0); opacity: 1 } } @keyframes home-diag-bar-fill { /* bar fill sweep */ } @keyframes home-diag-translate { /* row translate loop */ } ``` ### 6.4 Hero headline wipe (as on live site) ```html

Motion. Production-grade
animation library
for the web.

``` - Reveal: **left→right clip-path wipe** (`inset(0 100% 0 0)` → `inset(0 0 0 0)`), `ease-wipe` `cubic-bezier(.25,0,0,1)`, ~`0.55s`, staggered per line (~`0.25s` top offset per `inset` transition). - Sub-elements animate with `slide-up` (`opacity 0→1`, `translateY(8px)`). ### 6.5 Spring config (homepage “05 Spring physics” demo — verbatim) ```js transition: { type: "spring", stiffness: 260, damping: 10, mass: 1 } // ball: initial { y: -84 } → animate { y: 0 }, trigger cycle 1400–1800ms, first run delay 600ms ``` ### 6.6 Motion value loop (homepage “08 Motion values” — verbatim) ```js animate(mv, [-C, C, -C], { duration: 3.2, repeat: Infinity, ease: [.5, 0, .5, 1] }) ``` ### 6.7 Layout / exit demos (homepage) - **04 Layout:** `` cards toggle `data-state="grid" ↔ "row"` — shared-layout crossfade via default layout spring. - **06 Exit:** `` — element stays mounted, animates `exit` before removal. - **02 Scroll:** scroll-linked via `ScrollTimeline` / `scroll()` — `ease: a=>a` (linear), hardware-accelerated. - **03 Gestures:** `whileHover` / `whilePress` / `drag` — `hover`, `press`, `drag` labels. ### 6.8 Navigation rolling text Two copies in overflow-hidden box; on hover the current copy translates out and the `--incoming` copy translates in (transform only, `cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)`, ~`0.3s`). ### 6.9 Reduced motion Every animated component checks `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` → `transition: none` / static state. **Mandatory in implementation.** --- ## 7. Multi-Page Structure (⚠ `/studio` skipped) Shared chrome on every page: sticky yellow nav (§5.1) + **footer** = Partners logo wall (Platinum tier, “Discuss a partnership”) + Newsletter subscribe + legal/RSS links. ### Page 1 — `/` Home 1. **Full-bleed accent hero** (yellow band, `padding: 95px 0 56px`, pulls up `-139px` under nav): - Wipe-reveal H1: *“Motion.”* + subline *“Production-grade animation library for the web.”* - CTAs: **Get started** (primary) / **Browse examples** (secondary). - Ribbon: `> Prev Framer Motion. Available for: React · JavaScript · Vue`. - AI strip: “Using an AI agent? Install the Motion skill and MCP”. - MotionScore badge (`api.motion.dev/score/badge?url=motion.dev`). 2. **“Animations that move.”** — 12-col section heading (index `01 …`) + 8 numbered demo tiles: `01 Independent transforms · 02 Scroll animation · 03 Native gestures · 04 Layout animation · 05 Spring physics · 06 Exit animation · 07 Timeline sequences · 08 Motion values` (live mini-diagrams, exact configs §6.5–6.7) + React/JS/Vue tabs + “All documentation” link. 3. **“React & JavaScript animation examples.”** — spotlight card grid, hover video previews (poster.webp + preview.mp4), “Browse all examples”. 4. **“Documentation for React, JavaScript and Vue.”** — 3 columns (React / JavaScript / Vue) + “Browse all docs”. 5. **“Build faster with Motion+.”** — product callout with its own accent. 6. **“Made with Motion.”** — showcase gallery + “Submit your work”. 7. **“Latest from Motion.”** — two feeds side by side: Changelog (Added/Changed/Fixed tags, RSS) + Magazine articles (RSS). 8. **“Trusted by the world’s leading teams.”** — sponsor wall, partner tiers. 9. **“Tools for the full animation workflow.”** — rule-grid: AI Kit · Motion+ · CSS Studio · MotionScore. ### Page 2 — `/docs` - Header: H1 **Docs**. - **Platforms** cards → React / JavaScript / Vue doc roots (`/docs/react`, `/docs/js`, `/docs/vue`). - **Developer tools** (MotionScore, AI Kit / MCP, GSAP-vs-Motion, Performance, Troubleshooting). - **Popular pages** list (`quick-start`, `react-animation`, `react-transitions`, `scroll-animations`, `layout-animations`, `animate-presence`, `text-animation`, `svg-animation`, `tween`, `3d-transforms`…). - Doc article layout: left sidebar tree, center prose with code blocks, right “on this page” TOC; prev/next footer. - Signature motion: `docs-console-sweep` clip-path reveal on code consoles + `fade-in`/`slide-up` on section entry. ### Page 3 — `/examples` - H1 **Examples**, sub-filters: **Platform** (React/JS/Vue), **Categories**, **MotionScore** sort. - **Spotlight** hero card (large, autoplay preview), then masonry/grid of cards (4:3 hover-video, platform badge, heart favourite, mono meta). - Locked tier: “Unlock all 480+ examples” → Motion+ CTA. - Categories: gallery (showcase/archive/backstage/barrel), modal, carousel, drag, FAB, mega menu, parallax, skeleton shimmer, toast stack, typewriter, confetti, accordion, app store, scroll-linked, three.js TSL… ### Page 4 — `/ui` (Motion UI) - H1: **“Motion UI. Components that move like the products you love.”** - Sections: “See it in motion” (live embeds) → “Our animation, your design” (theme swap demo) → features: Consistent customisable motion · Delightful presets · Drops into your design · Adapt to your site with AI. - Catalogs: **Sections** grid, **Components** grid. - Gated: “Included in Motion+” + pricing Solo / Team. ### Page 5 — `/ai-kit` - H1 **AI Kit**. Hero demo “**Make me a…**” prompt builder. - Blocks: “Find and fix slow animations with MotionScore” · “Describe the feel. Get production-ready CSS.” · “More than context and audits.” - Pricing: **Free / Solo / Team**. ### Page 6 — `/plus` (Motion+ — purchase/checkout entry) - H1: “Build polished animations without starting from scratch.” + “Production-ready animation…” - Component showcase (each with live preview): **Carousel, AnimateNumber, Ticker, Cursor, Typewriter, ScrambleText, Curtains**. - Story blocks: “The hard part’s done. The fun part’s yours.” · “Your next page is already in motion.” · “Your agent, now a Motion expert.” - Pricing cards (Solo / Team, featured tier flips button to ink-on-paper), checkout via **Paddle overlay** (multi-step: plan select → Paddle modal → success), mint accent scheme for + pages. ### Page 7 — `/magazine` - H1 **Magazine**. Article list: title (H2) + meta + thumbnail; featured first (“Introducing Motion Studio” *article exists, page `/studio` itself still skipped*). RSS at `/magazine/rss.xml`. ### Page 8 — `/changelog` - H1 **Changelog**. Versioned rows: `Motion vX.Y.Z` + date + tags **Added / Changed / Fixed** (pill colors from palette), RSS at `/changelog/rss.xml`. Row hover = `slide-up`/`fade-in` entry. ### ❌ Skipped — `/studio` Not designed here per requirements (marked “New” in nav; excluded from this spec entirely). --- ## 8. Responsive Rules | Breakpoint | Behavior | |---|---| | `> 620px` | full nav labels, 72px bar, 12-col sections, 4-col rule grids | | `≤ 620px` | nav 60px, `top: 0`, brand mark only (word hidden), short link labels, CTA `padding: 9px` | | `≤ 360px` | nav gap 2px, links `padding-inline: 3px`, **search trigger hidden** | | Fluid | hero `clamp()`, gutters `clamp(20px,5vw,76px)`, section margins `clamp(44px,6vw,72px)` | ## 9. Accessibility & Perf - Focus-visible outlines everywhere (`2px currentColor, offset 3px`). - `prefers-reduced-motion` kills all transitions/animations. - Hardware-accelerated props only: `transform`, `opacity`, `clip-path`, `background-position`. - Images: `webp` posters + lazy `preview.mp4` crossfade; `aspect-ratio` reserved to avoid CLS. - Touch targets ≥ 44px (nav links), 32px on compact mobile nav. ## 10. Implementation Checklist - [ ] Tokens: fonts (TASA Orbiter + Geist Mono), color schemes (amber default + alts), fresh/lab oklch palette, grid vars - [ ] Shared chrome: sticky striped yellow nav with rolling-text hover, footer (partners + newsletter) - [ ] 8 pages: `/`, `/docs`, `/examples`, `/ui`, `/ai-kit`, `/plus`, `/magazine`, `/changelog` — **skip `/studio`** - [ ] Hero wipe-reveal (`clip-path: inset(0 100% 0 0) → inset(0)`, `cubic-bezier(.25,0,0,1)`) - [ ] Demo tile animations with **verbatim** configs (spring `260/10/1`, motion-value loop `3.2s ease [.5,0,.5,1]`, layout/exit/scroll/gesture/timeline demos) - [ ] Keyframes: `fade-in`, `slide-up`, `docs-console-sweep`, `home-showcase-pulse`, `home-diag-row`, `home-diag-bar-fill`, `home-diag-translate` - [ ] Hover micro-motion with `cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)` / `cubic-bezier(.25,1,.5,1)` per §6.1–6.2 - [ ] `prefers-reduced-motion` fallbacks
